# Business Agent Guide

> Choose one task that ends in a visible action, such as updating an order or routing a support case. Then compare the agent platforms that can complete it.

Published by AY Automate, a seller of AI implementation services. [Editorial policy and corrections](https://topaiagentsforbusiness.com/#editorial).

## Guide
- [AI agents for the systems your business already uses](https://topaiagentsforbusiness.com/)
- [Run a trial before giving an agent write access](https://topaiagentsforbusiness.com/worksheet/)
- [AI agent evaluation before the first live write](https://topaiagentsforbusiness.com/ai-agent-evaluation/)

## Provider sources
- [Microsoft Copilot Studio](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/microsoft-copilot-studio/agents-overview): Microsoft workflows. Provides tools to build agents. Test access with two employees who have different permissions on the same document.
- [Salesforce Agentforce](https://www.salesforce.com/agentforce/): CRM operations. Runs agents on the Salesforce platform. Ask which CRM records an agent can update and how those changes appear in the audit trail.
- [Google Cloud Agent Builder](https://docs.cloud.google.com/agent-builder): Cloud engineering. Provides services to build and manage agents on Google Cloud. Budget for the people who will operate the deployment.
- [Amazon Bedrock Agents](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/bedrock/latest/userguide/agents.html): Cloud engineering. AWS restricts Agents Classic to existing users. New buyers should evaluate AgentCore. Existing users can test model-driven actions with a narrowly scoped account.
- [SAP Joule Agents](https://learning.sap.com/courses/introducing-joule/getting-to-know-joule-agents_f9d18ca0-1021-4c1a-a044-4c00ec8c2898): ERP workflows. SAP describes agents for business processes. Check whether your target transaction and SAP edition are supported.
- [IBM watsonx Orchestrate](https://www.ibm.com/products/watsonx-orchestrate/ai-agents): Agent orchestration. Offers agents for business tasks. Ask for a demo using the same applications and access rules your users have.
- [Workato Agent Studio](https://docs.workato.com/en/agentic/agent-studio/faqs): Connected applications. Builds agents that work across business applications. Compare the cost and permissions of the connectors you need.
- [Zapier Agents](https://help.zapier.com/hc/en-us/articles/26028298697485-Use-actions-on-Zapier-Agents): App automation. Uses configured actions in connected applications. List the steps that should still require human approval.
- [UiPath](https://www.uipath.com/events/agentic-automation-launch): Agentic automation. Combines agents with process automation. Test an exception that needs a person to resume the workflow.
- [Capgemini](https://www.capgemini.com/news/client-stories/zf-friedrichshafen-establishes-a-global-rpa-service-in-a-single-year/): Process automation. Documents the rollout of a global robotic process automation service at ZF. Ask how the team handles process exceptions.
- [Remote MCP](https://topaiagentsforbusiness.com/mcp): search_firms, compare_firms and recommend_providers.
